notes:
T760 (needs-flag silent non-split) — FIXED, test-first. `managent add --needs T754,T755,T756` stored the needs list as the single element "T754,T755,T756" (a task ID that can never exist, silently blocking the row forever). Root cause: the `--needs` flag path in parseBundleMeta appended the raw string as one element (src/managent/main.zig:1538-1545), while the bundle-header `needs=` key split on commas. Fix: `--needs` now splits on commas via parseHoldsList (the same helper `--holds` uses), dedupes against the bundle's own `needs=`, and a new validateNeedsExist gate at add time refuses (loudly) any need that is not already registered, with an explicit escape `--allow-unregistered-needs <reason>` that records an amendment on the row (same pattern as --force on done, T424) so `managent show` names which rows carry an unregistered edge. Repaired-by-hand edge in the live store was NOT re-repaired; the code fix is the remedy.

TEST-FIRST (red→green): the comma-split test was written first and shown red — `add: --needs a,b,c splits into three needs (T760)` failed with `expected 3, found 1` against the pre-fix code — then the fix landed and it passed. Three new tests in src/managent/main.zig, wired into `zig build test` via the existing managent_tests step (no build.zig change needed): comma split (red→green), validateNeedsExist returns null when every need is registered, and validateNeedsExist records the escape for a missing need. The refusal path (exit 1) cannot be unit-asserted in-process; it is smoke-tested end-to-end against a scratch store (refusal names T754 T755 T756; escape registers and shows the amendment).

CENSUS of every list-typed flag on the CLI path in src/managent/main.zig (denominator: 5 CLI list flags + 3 bundle-header list keys):
- `--holds a,b` — comma-split via parseHoldsList (T539) — CORRECT; existence validation n/a (holds are file paths, not task IDs).
- `--needs <id,...>` — was NOT comma-split (THE defect) and had NO existence validation — BOTH FIXED THIS ROW.
- `--scope-targets <a,b,c>` — comma-split via parseHoldsList — CORRECT; existence validation n/a (file paths).
- `--seats <a,b,c>` — comma-split via parseHoldsList — CORRECT; validated against canonical model labels.
- `--exclude <a,b,c>` — comma-split (inline splitScalar) — CORRECT; validation downstream in model assignment (family/model names, not task IDs).
- Bundle-header keys: `holds=` (comma), `needs=` (comma) — both split correctly; `caps=` (space-split, not comma) — split correctly, but note it is space-delimited unlike the comma-delimited siblings.
- The brief's mention of `--caps` and `--candidates` as sibling flags is imprecise: neither exists as a CLI flag. `caps=` is a bundle-header key only; `candidates` is a computed assignment field, never a flag.

SAME-CLASS DEFECT FOUND, NOT FIXED (out of scope — this row owns only the add path): `managent needs <id> --add <dep>...` (cmdNeeds) adds dependency edges with NO existence validation — a `needs X --add NOPE` silently adds an unregistered need, the same forever-block class via a different entry point. It is multi-arg (space-separated), so it does not have the comma non-split bug, but it has the missing-existence-validation half of the defect. Recommended as a follow-up row.
